# Nook Community Kitchen: client facts

## Room and users
- Facility: Nook Community Kitchen
- Use: shared community cooking room
- Participants: adults with different first languages and cooking experience
- Participant responsibility: use and reset their own workstation
- Session host responsibility: opening, closing and departure checks
- Equipment: preparation benches; dedicated handwashing basin; separate utensil-washing sink; drying rack; electric hobs; storage counter with three open bays
- Graphic language, font and palette: open

## Operating sequence
| Order | Label | Action and object |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | WASH HANDS | Hands washed at the dedicated handwashing basin before preparation |
| 2 | PREPARE | Food preparation at a preparation bench |
| 3 | COOK | Cooking on an electric hob |
| 4 | SWITCH OFF | Current hob user switches off before handing over the station |
| 5 | CLEAN | Used utensils and workstation cleaned; hob cooling precedes hob wiping |
| 6 | RETURN | Clean, dry equipment returned to its assigned bay |

## Responsibility and storage
- Overview responsibility line: Every user resets their own station.
- Hob handover role: HOB USER
- Hob handover sequence: SWITCH OFF; LEAVE TO COOL
- Utensil sequence: WASH; RINSE; DRY; RETURN
- Storage order, viewer's left to right: BOARDS; COLANDERS; PANS
- Closing role: SESSION HOST
- Closing conditions: Hobs switched off; Work surfaces clear; Utensils clean and dry; Equipment in the right bays
- Departure card tick boxes: four; separate; empty
- Facility credit on each artwork: Nook Community Kitchen

## Artwork dimensions and reading conditions
| Artwork | Trim width × height | Location | Mounting centre above floor | Reading distance | Minimum printed letter height |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Overview wall guide | 400 × 600 mm | Entrance wall | 1500 mm | 2 m | 8 mm |
| Preparation sign | 300 × 300 mm | Wall beside dedicated handwashing basin | 1500 mm | 1 m | 5 mm |
| Hob reset sign | 300 × 300 mm | Wall above hob area | 1500 mm | 1 m | 5 mm |
| Wash-and-return strip | 480 × 270 mm | Wall above utensil sink and drying rack | 1500 mm | 1 m | 5 mm |
| Storage destination sign | 480 × 270 mm | Centred above three storage bays | 1500 mm | 1 m | 5 mm |
| Departure check card | 100 × 150 mm | Session host's clipboard | Handheld | 0.4 m | 3 mm |

- Bleed on each edge: 3 mm
- Minimum internal safe margin: 5 mm
- Minimum text-to-background contrast: 4.5:1
- Minimum meaningful-graphic-to-background contrast: 3:1
- Sequence cues: arrows or numbering alongside action graphics
- Working conditions: adults sharing counters and moving between stations

steps.userMessage:
NOOK COMMUNITY KITCHEN | Shared kitchen action signs

Nook Community Kitchen is opening a shared cooking room for adults with different first languages and levels of cooking experience. We need six finished artworks that make each person's next action and responsibility easy to recognise. The room has preparation benches, a dedicated handwashing basin, a separate utensil sink and drying rack, electric hobs and three open storage bays. Each participant resets their own workstation; the session host opens and closes the room.

The main sequence is WASH HANDS, PREPARE, COOK, SWITCH OFF, CLEAN, RETURN. Handwashing and utensil washing need distinct pictures. Switching off and leaving a hob to cool are separate actions. Facing the storage counter, the bays run BOARDS, COLANDERS, PANS from left to right. The graphic language, typography and colours are open. Print "Nook Community Kitchen" on all six artworks and "Every user resets their own station." on the overview. Use short labels beside recognisable actions and objects, with arrows or numbering carrying the sequence.

Audience: adults sharing the kitchen use the signs to choose their next action, and the session host uses the departure card to decide whether the room is ready to lock.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the shared operating facts, artwork dimensions and reading conditions. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the six delivery files with their proportions, formats and stages. kitchen-facts.en.md contains the equipment, responsibilities, local sequences and return rules. required-copy.en.md contains the exact wording assigned to each artwork. kitchen-installation.png locates each prompt relative to its equipment and gives its mounting dimensions. kitchen-equipment.png supplies the equipment forms that the action drawings refer to. kitchen-in-use.png supplies the context of adults sharing counters and moving between stations.

Deliverables:
1. One overview wall guide, 400 × 600 mm, headed SHARED KITCHEN, with six numbered action illustrations in the order WASH HANDS, PREPARE, COOK, SWITCH OFF, CLEAN, RETURN and the responsibility line
2. One preparation sign, 300 × 300 mm, headed BEFORE YOU PREPARE, with WASH HANDS followed by PREPARE and the instruction Use the handwashing basin.
3. One hob reset sign, 300 × 300 mm, headed HOB HANDOVER, addressing HOB USER, with SWITCH OFF followed by LEAVE TO COOL and the instruction Do not wipe a hot hob.
4. One wash-and-return strip, 480 × 270 mm, headed WASH AND RETURN, with four utensil illustrations in the order WASH, RINSE, DRY, RETURN
5. One storage destination sign, 480 × 270 mm, headed RETURN DRY EQUIPMENT, with BOARDS, COLANDERS, PANS and their equipment graphics aligned left to right above the three bays
6. One departure check card, 100 × 150 mm, headed BEFORE LOCKING UP, addressing SESSION HOST, with four empty tick boxes beside Hobs switched off; Work surfaces clear; Utensils clean and dry; Equipment in the right bays

Acceptance:
- All six artworks carry Nook Community Kitchen and their assigned wording from required-copy.en.md. The overview also carries Every user resets their own station. with its punctuation intact.
- The overview contains all six actions in the stated order. Its action drawings share recognisable objects and gestures with the preparation sign, hob reset sign, wash-and-return strip and storage destination sign; arrows or numbers establish the order independently of colour.
- The preparation sign depicts hands at the dedicated basin before preparation. The hob reset sign assigns both SWITCH OFF and LEAVE TO COOL to HOB USER in that order, and any hob-wiping illustration on the overview follows cooling.
- The wash-and-return strip depicts utensils through WASH, RINSE, DRY, RETURN, with drying before return. The storage destination sign pairs each equipment graphic with BOARDS, COLANDERS or PANS in the viewer's left-to-right bay order.
- The departure check card assigns all four listed conditions to SESSION HOST, with exactly four separate, empty tick boxes. Its equipment pictures match the corresponding wall signs.
- All six artworks use their listed trim dimensions, 3 mm bleed and an internal safe margin of at least 5 mm. Minimum printed letter height is 8 mm on the overview for reading at 2 m, 5 mm on the four local signs for reading at 1 m, and 3 mm on the card for reading at 0.4 m. Text has at least 4.5:1 contrast against its background, and meaningful graphics at least 3:1.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
